analysis.visual_description: On the tables. Evening in the lane off Bishopsgate Street. An upper shutter stands open. The writing-tables are in his hand, clasped shut. Music comes from the window, a pavan taken slowly.
On the tables. The tables are open on a clean leaf. The stylus does not touch it. The music stops on a hard place in the left hand, goes back over it, and takes it again.

On the tables. The hard place is played through, as if it had never been hard. A lid shuts. He stands no longer than a man might to get a stone out of his shoe, and he clasps the tables with nothing on the leaf.
